run_ufmt_linter: run the ufmt linter on one or more Python files to check formatting with black and usort
check_file_formatting: check a single Python file for formatting issues using ufmt and return lint messages
create_lint_message: create a LintMessage named tuple with path, severity, code, and optional original and replacement content
format_error_message: format an exception into a LintMessage with ADVICE severity for failed lint operations
use_lint_severity: use the LintSeverity enum to classify lint issues as ERROR, WARNING, ADVICE, or DISABLED
